required_before_geometry: Download only the selected HABS measured sheets and caption pages needed for the two primary structures.
Record retrieval date, final URL, byte count, and SHA-256 for every acquired artifact.
Confirm drawing scale and north arrow are legible before measurement extraction.
required_before_projection: Resolve item-level authorship and rights for each selected image.
Confirm each image depicts the intended John Moulton structure.
Require at least two useful exterior elevations for the barn and house.
